### REVOLVE Extends Its World of Fashion and Cultural Influence to Print with Debut Magazine


September 29, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s203.q4cdn.com/458606031/files/doc_news/REVOLVE-Extends-Its-World-of-Fashion-and-Cultural-Influence-to-Print-with-Debut-Magazine-2026.pdf)


REVOLVE Magazine debuts with three distinct covers featuring Kendall Jenner, Teyana Taylor, and Alex Consani


LOS ANGELES


, Sept. 29, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- **REVOLVE** , the leading fashion destination for the next generation of consumers, today launches **REVOLVE Magazine** , a new annual print and digital publication that brings the world of **REVOLVE** to life through the people, places, brands and experiences that have shaped it.


For more than two decades, **REVOLVE** has pioneered new ways to connect fashion, culture and community, from influencer trips and immersive experiences to its evolution into physical retail. **REVOLVE Magazine** brings that story together in one place, celebrating what has inspired the brand, the community that has grown alongside it and what's next. Featuring three covers with **Kendall Jenner, Teyana Taylor and Alex Consani** , the magazine explores fashion, beauty, culture, travel and commerce through the lens of REVOLVE, with exclusive talent stories, expert style and product curation, and a seamlessly shoppable experience.


"REVOLVE has always been about doing things differently and creating new ways to connect with our customers. We've pioneered formats and experiences that have reshaped how our industry connects with culture, and the magazine is another expression of that. In a world that's increasingly short-form and digital, we wanted to create something that lets us slow down and have a longer conversation with our customers. It's an extension of the REVOLVE personality and a physical manifestation of the energy, culture, and point of view REVOLVE represents." - **Michael Mente, Co-Founder & Co-CEO, REVOLVE Group Inc**


To bring the magazine to life, **REVOLVE** partnered with powerhouse creative agency **Baron & Baron** , alongside a roster of leading creative talent including photographers **Fabien Baron** and **Carin Backoff** , stylists **Dara Allen** and **Daniel Gaines** , and **Natalie Tauger** , who joined as Fashion Director.


The inaugural issue features original fashion and beauty stories, profiles of notable cultural voices and trend-focused editorial from **REVOLVE's** buying and merchandising teams. Going beyond what to wear, the magazine explores where to go, what to do and what's next. It also introduces **The R List** , a curated guide to Los Angeles featuring places personally recommended by **REVOLVE Group Co-Founder and Co-CEO Michael Mente** and **President, Brand & Partnerships Raissa Gerona** , giving readers an insider's perspective on the places and experiences that are part of the **REVOLVE** lifestyle.


"We've always believed there was a bigger REVOLVE story to tell. REVOLVE has grown beyond retail into a lifestyle shaped by fashion, discovery, travel, culture and the experiences that bring our community together," said **Raissa Gerona, President, Brand & Partnerships, REVOLVE Group Inc** . "The magazine gives us a place to bring that world together, celebrating the people, places and ideas that have shaped us and continue to inspire us. It's a reflection of who we are and a new way to invite our customers into the REVOLVE world."


The launch coincides with the arrival of the fall collection from **REVOLVE's** namesake label, **REVOLVE Los Angeles** , available online at **REVOLVE** and **FWRD** and in stores. Featuring aspirational names in fashion that speak directly to the REVOLVE customer, including **Teyana Taylor, Kendall Jenner, Alex Consani, Anok Yai** and **Irina Shayk** , the issue showcases pieces from the new collection throughout, further connecting the magazine's editorial storytelling to **REVOLVE's** product universe.


Looking ahead, **REVOLVE Magazine** will continue to evolve alongside its community, with future issues exploring themes and cultural conversations through the **REVOLVE** point of view, from music and sports to travel and beyond. The annual publication creates a new canvas for deeper storytelling, emerging voices, curated recommendations, playlists, and the people and experiences shaping what's next.


**REVOLVE Magazine** will be available digitally and in stores beginning **September 29** and will publish annually.


**Media Contact:**revolveus@karlaotto.com


**About REVOLVE Group, Inc.** Revolve Group, Inc. (NYSE: RVLV) is the next-generation fashion retailer for Millennial and Generation Z consumers. As a trusted premium lifestyle brand and a go-to online source for discovery and inspiration, REVOLVE delivers an engaging customer experience from a vast, yet curated, offering of apparel, footwear, accessories, and beauty styles. A dynamic platform connects a deeply engaged community of millions of consumers, thousands of global fashion influencers, and more than 1,600 emerging, established, and owned brands.
